description:
Job Title: Senior .Net Developer (2 Positions)
 Location: Boise, ID 50131
 Duration: 6+ months 
 Top Qualifications :
 +5 years in a Senior .Net Developer Role.
 Strong Verbal and Written Communication skills.
 Strong MVC / C#
 Strong knowledge of T-SQL stored procedure and database design experience required
 Ability to unit test and produce well documented code
 Work with Visual Studio and TFS
 NOTES: A plus if they understand: Full stack development (Backend, Middle, Front End), WCF, Elastic (NoSQL), Inside Commerce experience a plus but not mandatory. 
 Developers need to have the skill set listed below and will need to hit the ground running. Microsoft .Net senior developer with more than 5 years' experience using the Microsoft stack of development tools Visual Studio 2015 (C# as the primary language). The eligible candidate must have the following skills:
 Ability to unit test code base with well documented coding standards
 SASS / CSS / Bootstrap
 Angular 1.5 / React
 Middle tier
 MVC / C#
 Back end development
 SQL Server 2014 (DB2 a plus but not necessary)
 Database table structure design
 T-SQL stored procedure experience required
 WCF (Window Communication Foundation)
 Elastic Search experience
 Visual Studio 2015 (Required)
 Microsoft SQL Server Management
 Bit Bucket / TFS
 Experience working in an agile methodology a plus
 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
